title: Chicken 65 (Crispy, Juicy, Authentic)
description: Chicken 65 is a popular South Indian fried chicken appetizer featuring juicy boneless chicken coated in a spiced yogurt marinade, cornflour, and rice flour for a crisp exterior. A quick tempering of garlic, green chilies, curry leaves, and Kashmiri chili gives it its signature restaurant-style aroma and flavor.

ingredients.title: For the Chicken & Marinade
items: Boneless chicken thighs – 600 g, cut into 1½-inch cubes
Fresh green chili paste – 1 tsp, adjust to taste
Fresh curry leaf paste – 1 tbsp, or finely crushed curry leaves

ingredients.title: For Frying
items: Neutral oil – as required, preferably peanut or sunflower oil

ingredients.title: For Tempering & Finishing
items: Kashmiri red chili powder – ½ tsp

instruction.title: Step 1 – Marinating the Chicken
steps: In a stainless-steel bowl, combine all the marinade ingredients except the 1 tsp neutral oil.
Add the chicken pieces and massage thoroughly for 2–3 minutes until the marinade becomes tacky and coats the chicken evenly.
Add 1 tsp oil and mix again to help lock in moisture.
Cover and rest for a minimum of 45 minutes. For deeper flavor and tenderness, refrigerate for 6–8 hours.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Frying the Chicken
steps: Fry the chicken in small batches to prevent the oil temperature from dropping.
Fry for 4–5 minutes, turning once, until the chicken develops a deep golden-red color and crisp exterior.
Ensure the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 74°C.
Remove the chicken and let it rest on a wire rack to preserve its crispness.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Aromatic Tempering
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wide sauté pan.
Add chopped garlic and sauté until lightly golden, taking care not to brown it too much.
Add slit green chilies and curry leaves carefully.
Add Kashmiri chili powder and a pinch of sugar.
Add the fried chicken and toss quickly over high heat for 30–40 seconds.
Finish with lemon juice and immediately switch off the heat.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Plating and Serving
steps: Serve the Chicken 65 hot in a shallow serving bowl.
Garnish with fried curry leaves, lemon wedges, and thinly sliced green chilies.
Serve with onion rings or mint yogurt dip if desired.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot as an appetizer or small plate.
Garnish with fried curry leaves, lemon wedges, and thinly sliced green chilies.
Pair with onion rings or a cooling mint yogurt dip.

chefTips: Rice flour combined with egg white helps maintain a crisp coating for longer.
Use boneless chicken thighs for juicy, tender results during high-heat frying.
MSG is optional but can add the characteristic umami associated with some restaurant-style Chicken 65.
Keep the tempering fast and hot so the fried chicken gets coated without becoming soggy.
Rest fried chicken on a wire rack rather than paper towels to help preserve its crisp exterior.
Marinating for 6–8 hours gives the chicken deeper flavor while keeping the texture tender.
